value.rationale: For the canonical twenty-vertex dodecahedral graph, the total three-cut complex is pure sixteen-dimensional yet has the complete integral homotopy type of 54 fourteen-spheres. The resulting nonshellability and exact 120-element rational homology character, with only two invariant classes and a 30/24 antipodal split, give a motivated nonchordal Platonic benchmark beyond sphere counts alone.
